about: DRAFT (2026-10-18, for the owner's approval; not wired into any script): the ladder of 150 Days of AI on the LearnAI floor (@ai.learnvora, renamed from ig.learnai by the owner on 2026-10-18): one idea per day, in this order. Day titles are our own wording of concepts. The topic titles of roadmap.sh/ai-engineer are used only as a checklist, through roadmap/ai-engineer.json (every one of its 65 units appears here); roadmap.sh text is copyrighted and is never copied into reels, captions or this repo. Scripts, examples and numbers come from primary sources fetched in the session. The owner decides changes to this file. Revised 2026-10-19 on the owner's word: the four opening days (what an AI engineer does, the roles, AI vs ML vs DL, AI vs AGI) taught nothing a viewer could use, so the ladder opens with how a model learns. Four new days were added to phase S1 (train/validation/test, overfitting, pretraining, training vs inference), so the total stays 150 and Days 11 to 150 keep their numbers.
rules: Day N is item id a + N in three digits (Day 7 = a007) if the owner approves the prefix a (proposal 2026-10-18-learnvora-and-150-days-of-ai.md). Days are made in order; none is skipped without the owner.

Each reel is stand-alone: one idea, terms defined inside it, the day is only a label on the cover and in the caption. The script never says yesterday, kal, Part N or next video, and never points at another day or at a course reel.
A day is done when its reel is published (status done); in_progress when planned or built.
formats: concept, structure, pattern, demo, myth-bust, recap, and trade-off (X vs Y, which one when: a proposed addition, as on the System Design floor).

The series teaches the idea in one picture; the course track (r###) teaches the working version of the same unit (steps, a worked example, the trade-off). The same unit is never on both tracks within 7 days.

unit (optional): the unit of roadmap/ai-engineer.json the day belongs to. note (optional): the reel that already taught this idea; the planner takes a different angle (another format or picture), because rule 12 (60 days) is read for the angle, not the concept, on series days. Both keys are planner hints and may be dropped when the file is adopted.
